query:
insert into SchemaContentMediaTypes (
                        latest_collection,
                        schema_hash,
                        media_type,
                        entry_number
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4
                    )
                    on conflict (
                        schema_hash,
                        media_type
                    ) do update
                    set
                        latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                        entry_number = excluded.entry_number
